A dip in local stock markets, with the Nifty 50 falling 0.4%, overshadowed these boosts. Increased dollar demand from foreign banks also pressured the rupee. Investors are closely watching US economic data, particularly the upcoming jobs report, for clues on potential Federal Reserve rate hikes later this year.

title: The AI boom won't burst all at once. It will pop in 'rolling bubbles': Macquarie
description: Macquarie expects the AI investment boom to unwind through a series of "rolling bubbles" rather than a single crash, as different segments of the AI ecosystem heat up and cool down over time. Global AI investment has surged to about $850 billion in 2026, far exceeding historical technology booms.

title: Blue Star MD flags 2% margin drop this summer but bets big on data centres for long-term growth
description: Blue Star experienced a robust summer AC sales season, but rising input costs significantly impacted profit margins.  The company's MD anticipates continued margin pressure, revising full-year guidance downwards.  While the festive season offers a glimmer of hope for recovery, Blue Star is strategically investing in the high-growth data centre cooling sector, aiming for substantial revenue contribution by FY29.

title: Goldman backs India 30-year bonds as Iran war impact contained
description: Goldman Sachs has recommended buying India's 30-year government bonds, citing easing inflation expectations, lower oil prices and reduced fiscal risks after the US-Iran ceasefire. The brokerage believes the long end of the bond curve offers better value as shorter-term bonds have already rallied.
